brief:
The UK Supreme Court will hear a landmark appeal challenging the government's ban on Palestine Action, Middle East Eye reported. The case tests the limits of British counterterrorism law as the government defends its decision to proscribe the activist group.

The appeal represents a significant legal test of how UK authorities apply terror legislation to domestic protest movements focused on Palestinian issues.
dek: UK Supreme Court to hear landmark appeal over Palestine Action ban The British government will defend its decision to ban Palestine Action at the UK Supreme Court, in a landmark case that continues to test the boundaries of British counterterror legislation,…
title: UK Supreme Court hears appeal of Palestine Action terror ban
